segments.ja329:1.1: Yaṃ annapānassa pure labhāma, taṃ dāni sākhamigameva gacchati;
segments.ja329:1.3: Gacchāma dāni vanameva rādha, asakkatā casma dhanañjayāya [dhanañcayāya (ka.)].
segments.ja329:2.1: Lābho alābho yaso ayaso ca, nindā pasaṃsā ca sukhañca dukkhaṃ;
segments.ja329:2.3: Ete aniccā manujesu dhammā, mā soci kiṃ socasi poṭṭhapāda.
segments.ja329:3.1: Addhā tuvaṃ paṇḍitakosi rādha, jānāsi atthāni anāgatāni;
segments.ja329:3.3: Kathaṃ nu sākhāmigaṃ dakkhisāma [dakkhiyāma (ka.), dakkhāma (syā.)], niddhāvitaṃ [niddhāpitaṃ (sī. syā.), nibbāpitaṃ (pī.), nicchadaṃ (ka.)] rājakulatova jammaṃ.
segments.ja329:4.1: Cāleti kaṇṇaṃ bhakuṭiṃ karoti, muhuṃ muhuṃ bhāyayate [bhāyate (syā.), bhāyāpate (ka.)] kumāre;
segments.ja329:4.3: Sayameva taṃ kāhati kāḷabāhu, yenārakā ṭhassati annapānāti.

lines: Tattha yaṃ annapānassāti yaṃ annapānaṃ assa rañño santikā.
Upayogatthe vā sāmivacanaṃ.
Dhanañjayāyāti karaṇatthe sampadānavacanaṃ, dhanañjayena.
Asakkatā casmāti annapānaṃ na labhāma, iminā ca na sakkatamhāti attho.
Taṃ sutvā rādho dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Lābho alābho yaso ayaso ca, nindā pasaṃsā ca sukhañca dukkhaṃ;
Ete aniccā manujesu dhammā, mā soci kiṃ socasi poṭṭhapādā”ti.
Tattha yasoti issariyaparivāro.
Ayasoti tassābhāvo.
Eteti ete aṭṭha lokadhammā manujesu aniccā, lābhaggayasaggappattā hutvāpi aparena samayena appalābhā appasakkārā honti, niccalābhino nāma na honti.
Yasādīsupi eseva nayo.
Taṃ sutvā poṭṭhapādo makkaṭe usūyaṃ apanetuṃ asakkonto tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Addhā tuvaṃ paṇḍitakosi rādha, jānāsi atthāni anāgatāni;
Kathaṃ nu sākhāmigaṃ dakkhisāma, niddhāvitaṃ rājakulatova jamman”ti.
Tattha kathaṃ nūti kena nu kho upāyena.
Dakkhisāmāti dakkhissāma.
Niddhāvitanti nivuṭṭhāpitaṃ nikkaḍḍhāpitaṃ.
Jammanti lāmakaṃ.
Taṃ sutvā rādho catutthaṃ gāthamāha –
“Cāleti kaṇṇaṃ bhakuṭiṃ karoti, muhuṃ muhuṃ bhāyayate kumāre;
Sayameva taṃ kāhati kāḷabāhu, yenārakā ṭhassati annapānā”ti.
Tattha bhāyayate kumāreti rājakumāre utrāseti.
Yenārakā ṭhassati annapānāti yena kāraṇena imamhā annapānā dūre ṭhassati, sayameva taṃ kāraṇaṃ karissati, mā tvaṃ etassa cintayīti attho.
